questions.question_text: Explain one reason why cache memory can improve processor performance.

mark_scheme_points.point_text: Cache stores frequently used data or instructions
The processor can access cache faster than main memory

questions.question_text: Describe how a binary search reduces the remaining search space.

mark_scheme_points.point_text: The sorted list is divided into two parts
The half that cannot contain the item is discarded

questions.question_text: Determine the value of x if 3x + 4 = 19.
Explain what happens to the acceleration of an object when the resultant force is doubled and its mass is unchanged.

mark_scheme_points.point_text: Acceleration is directly proportional to resultant force

questions.question_text: Describe how a complex number is represented on an Argand diagram.

mark_scheme_points.point_text: The real part is plotted on the horizontal axis
The imaginary part is plotted on the vertical axis
